categories.claimBoundary: Traces 26 reviewed generated tokens across four frozen Babel maps and live Rust maps to authored line and UTF-16 columns: thirteen positions are exact parity and thirteen are explicit Rust precision improvements over coarser Babel positions. The fourth fixture composes a generated intermediate TSX file through two authored sources, sourceRoot, sourcesContent, and an ignore list before compiler lowering. Eight native probe suites add deeper lowering coverage, including erased TypeScript class fields and multiline JSX. Native-only probes are not Babel equivalence evidence; this does not assert identical generated-token layouts, every upstream map shape, or exhaustive token equivalence.
